inlines.v: TRAN'QUIL, adjective [Latin tranquillus.] Quiet; calm; undisturbed; peaceful; not agitated. The atmosphere is tranquil The state is tranquil A tranquil retirement is desirable; but a tranquil mind is essential to happiness.
